bullets: Traceability from requirements to test cases

slides.title: A long list is continued on a second slide
bullets: Klocwork warnings are exported per module and pre-triaged so reviewers only see findings that need a human decision
GTest skeletons follow the project template, keep requirement IDs in the test header and target full CTC coverage
Flash and debug runs produce a console log, a JSON record and an HTML report for every step
CANoe automation reads and writes signals, system variables and diagnostics without opening the GUI
Doxygen module specifications are generated or updated from the code, including PlantUML diagrams
Jira tickets are analysed against the code base and a fix proposal is prepared for review
Confluence pages can be read, updated or created, and turned into Jira tickets after approval
Release workflow verifies a clean install, writes the changelog and tags the version on main
PMS metric workbooks are audited and red metrics are linked to the functions that cause them
I2C traffic to monitor and touch MCUs can be scripted through the Aardvark adapter
Robot Framework suites for S3P SITS are generated from requirements with ASPICE-compliant documentation blocks
Requirement and test specification lookups run against the project knowledge base without leaving the editor
Variant headers and superset coverage are generated for modules with several build variants
Screen recordings can be captured and exported as a sped-up GIF or MP4 for bug reports
Commit orchestration validates staged changes across all repositories of a meta-repo before committing

cards.heading: Faster builds
cards.body: Scripted build and flash flow replaces manual multi-step setup on the bench.

cards.heading: Better tests
cards.body: Generated test skeletons follow the project template and keep requirement traces.

cards.heading: Fewer reviews
cards.body: Static-analysis triage is pre-sorted so reviewers focus on real findings.

cards.heading: Shared know-how
cards.body: Skills capture bench knowledge once and make it available to every team, so new colleagues can run the same flows from day one without asking for a walkthrough.
